top_products.answer: Americano with milk is your biggest earner: 44 sales bringing in 1,100, about 16% of all revenue. The latte is second on revenue despite selling half as often, because it's your highest-priced drink. Keep both permanently stocked and consider a latte promotion at quiet times, since each extra latte earns a third more than an americano.

top_products.answer_zh: 加奶美式是最赚钱的饮品：售出44杯，收入1,100，约占总收入的16%。拿铁收入排第二，虽然销量只有一半，但它是价格最高的饮品。两者都应保持充足库存，并可考虑在客流较少时推出拿铁优惠，因为每多卖一杯拿铁，比美式多赚三分之一。

payment.answer: 182 of 262 sales (69%) were paid by card. Card customers spend 26.75 per drink on average versus 25.26 for cash, so the difference is small. Since most customers already prefer card, it is reasonable to keep cash handling minimal, but a card-only policy would risk losing roughly three in ten customers.

result = summary.round(2).to_dict()
payment.answer_zh: 262笔销售中有182笔（69%）刷卡支付。刷卡顾客平均每杯消费26.75，现金顾客为25.26，差别不大。既然大多数顾客已习惯刷卡，可以尽量减少现金处理；但如果只收卡，可能会流失约三成顾客。

weekday.answer: Sunday is your strongest day and Tuesday the weakest, with about 3.2 times the revenue. Schedule your most experienced staff on the busiest day and use the quietest one for stock-taking or a mid-week offer to lift footfall.

general.answer: Across the six weeks the shop sold 262 drinks for a total of 6,890, an average of 26.30 per drink and about 168 per trading day. The simplest lever is price mix: nudging even a few americano buyers towards a latte would lift the average sale without needing more customers.

store_general.answer: Electronics brings in by far the most revenue, 895,402 from 507 purchases, about 63% of the total. Footwear sells the most items (983) but earns 141,142, because a typical pair costs around 144 against 1,775 for an electronics purchase. Groceries is smallest at 14,016. Electronics stock levels and pricing deserve the most attention, and growing footwear and sports would make revenue less dependent on one department.

store_general.answer_zh: 电子产品的收入遥遥领先：507笔购买带来895,402，约占总收入的63%。鞋类卖出的件数最多（983件），收入却只有141,142，因为一双鞋约144，而一笔电子产品购买约1,775。食品杂货最少，为14,016。电子产品的库存和定价最值得关注；发展鞋类和运动品类，可以降低收入对单一部门的依赖。

bakery_cash.answer: Your cash is falling because the bakery has spent more than it earned every month since June: 66,094 a month on average over the last three months. Shop sales are the main cause, at about 233,000 a month in September and October against about 295,000 in November to January. Payroll also rose by 8,000 a month in June. The quickest ways to buy time are lifting weekday sales and agreeing longer payment terms with your ingredient supplier, while you decide whether to borrow.
bakery_cash.answer_zh: 现金减少是因为从6月起每个月的支出都超过收入，最近三个月平均每月缺口66,094元。主要原因是门店销售下滑：9至10月每月约233,000元，而11月至1月每月约295,000元。此外，6月起工资每月增加了8,000元。争取时间最快的办法是提升工作日销售，并与原料供应商商定更长的付款期限，同时考虑是否需要融资。

bakery_costs.answer: Payroll and ingredients are 80% of what you spent in the last 90 days (442,500 and 350,536). Ingredient spending has stayed high while shop sales fell, so ordering to match the lower sales is the quickest saving: 10% less on ingredients saves about 11,685 a month. Next, review weekday staffing, since payroll rose 8,000 a month in June even though sales dropped. Rent is fixed for now.
bakery_costs.answer_zh: 最近90天的支出中，工资和原料占80%（分别为442,500元和350,536元）。门店销售下降，原料支出却一直偏高，所以按较低的销量调整采购是最快的节省办法：原料少用10%，每月约可节省11,685元。其次是检查工作日的排班，因为6月起工资每月增加了8,000元，而销售却在下降。房租短期内无法调整。
